content.rendered:
As all Sherwood students in grades 6-12 have a Chromebook assigned to them, the District offers a Device Protection Plan. This optional program allows families to pay a $15 fee at the start of each school year in order to pay reduced rates on applicable damage and loss charges for their student’s device.

The form linked below provides information about the details of the plan’s coverage. If you wish to enroll in the Device Protection Plan for the current school year, please complete the form and pay the $15 fee that has been added to your student’s account. — Fee payments are due by October 15th.

If you have any questions about the Device Protection Plan, please contact your school’s office.
